newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ dwelling estimates continue to show growth - SNZ.
newsitem.headline: NZ dwelling estimates continue to show growth - SNZ.

text.p: Provisional dwelling authorisation statistics for January 1997 show that the short term trend estimate for new dwelling unit authorisations is continuing to increase, Statistics New Zealand said on Friday.
The trend estimate increased 2.1 percent from December 1996 to January 1997.
"An estimated 1,632 new dwelling units were authorised for construction in Jnauary 1997. This is 7.9 percent more than in January 1996," SNZ said.
